title: The Wall of Pawns
setup: Black's pawn shield on **f7**, **g7**, **h7** is intact — but with no escape window, that's a death sentence.
hint: Slide the rook up the open file. Black's own pawns do the rest.
explanation:
## The Idea

This is the back-rank mate in its purest form: an open file, an empty back rank, and three pawns in front of the king.

{{Rd8#}} checks along the eighth rank. f8 and h8 are on the rook's line, f7, g7 and h7 hold Black's own pawns, and nothing can block or capture.

The cure is simple: push one of those pawns a square earlier to give the king a way out.
